Only hashed Linux setup is adapted. Linux CUBIC, buffer autotuning, metrics flushing, qdisc configuration and other defaults are not reproduced; Reno is used for non-SACK recovery. Profile mismatches remain test failures, not assertion edits.

The source spells ../../common/defaults.sh, which does not resolve to tcp/common/defaults.sh from this script directory. The audited semantic mapping explicitly uses pinned tcp/common/defaults.sh, without executing that upstream path.
The upstream-basic profile uses immediate ACKs for these short scripted exchanges; TCP core delayed-ACK defaults remain unchanged.

Explicit abort_with_ack emits RST|ACK with ACK=RCV.NXT only for handshake-completed synchronized local aborts; the core default remains bare RST. Negotiated timestamps echo TS.Recent when ACK is set (RFC 7323 section 3.2). Reactive reset formatting is unchanged.
Single-packet PTO uses an explicit 200 ms peer ACK-delay budget; FIN probes retain the unarmed RTO reference and exponential RTO backoff.
